verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents payment webhooks that "track the status of payments and order lifecycle events" for its checkout product, which gives backends pushed order-status notifications. However, its Agent Checkouts product is explicitly poll-driven with "no webhooks in v1", so agent purchase orders cannot be subscribed to. Missing for 10: an enumerated event catalog covering created/updated/fulfilled/canceled, webhook support for agent checkout orders, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery.
